$$
\text{New value} = \text{Original value} + (\text{Increase in value}) = 80,000 + (150\% \times 80,000) = 80,000 + 120,000 = 200,000
$$

Now, the profit is the difference between the new value and the original cost:

$$
\text{Profit} = \text{New value} - \text{Original cost} = 200,000 - 80,000 = 120,000
$$
